name: undo-pill
title: Undo Pill
description: After a row is deleted, a compact undo bar appears near the bottom edge with a countdown ring, a message and an Undo button. It fades when time runs out or bounces away after a restore.
use: A destructive action needs a short, forgiving window to reverse it without opening a dialog.
avoid: Bulk or permanent deletes, and simple pages that would rather not hold host state for the removed item.
a11y: Undo is a real button and Escape works, but the ticking digit lives inside an aria-hidden ring so time left is never announced. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A small white rounded pill on a dark inbox: a tiny circular ring holding a digit at the left, a short label, a dot and an underlined Undo word. Above it the inbox card is dark grey with rounded rows and small trash icons.
behaves: The pill springs up from below when a message is deleted and drains its ring while the digit counts down. Hovering or focusing pauses the count; pressing Undo makes it bounce out, and running out of time fades it away.
customise: Label, duration, undo text, pause behaviour and className are props; open, onUndo and onExpire need host wiring. Colours are fixed in Tailwind classes.
weight: light: One small pill and a single animation-frame timer that stops when it closes.
demo: Inbox rows from Maya Lin, Daniel Okafor and Sofia Ramirez, labelled Message deleted
issues: The seconds digit inside the countdown ring is only nine pixels tall and hard to read at this scale.
polishWhy: Crisp pill and solid countdown on a clean inbox; the tiny digit keeps it just short of top.
